It says on WW's Black Hand preview that the appropriate files on their
site will be updated next monday, 24th of November.

> I'm trying out this new Vamp program (as mentioned elsewhere in this
> group), but it's not so useful without BH cards. Although at least i
> did find the grouping tool/filtery thing. :)
> salem
> domain:canberra http://www.geocities.com/salem_christ.geo/vtes.htm

I've tried Vamp today and I'm way too impressed with it. Though it has
some problems - it's not as intuitive as ELDB, at least for beginners
on VTES; I think it needs more space for filter results, to avoid as
many browsing up-and-down as possible; and some other minor things -
the new options on filtering, saving partial results, the pushpin
column and the icons are very welcome. One just needs some time to
adapt to it, but it's worth the download and support from players. I'm
going to use it from now on, surely.
